labels.rationale: Rich already supports orange via named colours (orange1, dark_orange) and hex values; this is a how-to question.

items.body:
Rich already supports orange text. Use a named colour such as `orange1` or `dark_orange`, or a hex value such as `#ff8700`, in a style, for example `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")` or `console.print("[orange1]Hello[/]")`.

The colour names are listed in this file: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/color.py

The colour syntax is described in the style docs: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst

If you need something this does not cover, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) first.
